# UUStreak

> UUStreak is a web application that tracks WCAG compliance for Norwegian websites and provides a streak score for days without accessibility violations.

Area: Norway. Languages: Norwegian and English.

## Overview
UUStreak is a Norwegian web application that monitors the accessibility compliance
 of websites in Norway. It uses automated testing to identify WCAG violations and
 calculates a streak score representing the number of consecutive days without violations.

## Key Features
- Tracks WCAG compliance for Norwegian websites
- Provides a streak score for days without accessibility violations
- Offers detailed reports on accessibility issues
- Includes a heatmap visualization of accessibility violations
- Provides trend analysis of accessibility improvements
- Publishes machine-readable JSON resources at
  `historical-data/report-list.json` and `historical-data/streak-index.json`

## Technical Details
- Built with Playwright and AXE for automated testing
- Runs on GitHub Actions for continuous monitoring
- Provides static JSON data under `historical-data/` for audit reports and streak scores;
  these are static resources, not an `/api` service
- Designed to be accessible and compliant with WCAG standards itself

## Related AI-agent skills
[wcag-skill](https://clawhub.ai/turbolego/skills/wcag-skill) is a related skill
for AI agents building, auditing, and repairing WCAG 2.2 web content. It combines
automated audit tooling with an evidence matrix and manual accessibility checks;
automated results alone do not prove WCAG conformance.
- [ClawHub listing](https://clawhub.ai/turbolego/skills/wcag-skill)
- [GitHub documentation and source](https://github.com/turbolego/wcag-skill)
- [Agent skills discovery index](https://uustreak.no/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json):
  a pinned wcag-skill archive with a SHA-256 integrity digest.
